about.en: MUSE Lab stands for **Multimodal Understanding and Synthesis for Explainability**. The Muses were the Greek goddesses of art and inspiration: we want generative AI to be just as creative, and at the same time **controllable, interpretable and trustworthy**.
about.zh: MUSE Lab 的全称是 **Multimodal Understanding and Synthesis for Explainability**，即“面向可解释性的多模态理解与生成”。MUSE 也是希腊神话中司掌艺术与灵感的缪斯女神：我们希望生成式 AI 像缪斯一样富有创造力，同时**可控、可解释、值得信任**。

text.en: Images, video and language, modelled together.
text.zh: 联合建模图像、视频与语言。

text.en: Knowing what a model sees, and why it fails.
text.zh: 看懂模型理解了什么、为什么会出错。

text.en: Generating and editing content with precise control.
text.zh: 精确、可控地生成与编辑内容。

text.en: Opening the black box, so that people can trust it.
text.zh: 打开黑箱，让人能够信任。

summary.en: Why diffusion models fail on certain concepts, and how to generate and edit images and videos precisely while keeping meaning and identity intact.
summary.zh: 探究扩散模型为何在特定概念上失效，在保持语义与身份不变的前提下，精确地生成与编辑图像和视频。

topics.zh: 保持身份的图像与视频编辑
生成式编辑的可靠性评估

cover.alt: Illustration: a canvas of noise turning into a mountain landscape, with a film strip and a paintbrush

summary.en: LLMs and agents that stay reliable through long dialogues and multi-agent workflows: they keep to their constraints, catch their own mistakes and can show their sources.
summary.zh: 让大模型与智能体在长程对话与多智能体协作中保持可靠：守得住约束、查得出错误、说得出依据。

topics.zh: 幻觉风险的预测与干预
多智能体交接中的约束保持
代码生成的反思式搜索

cover.alt: Illustration: AI agents linked in a network above a chat bubble, a shield with a check mark and a checklist

summary.en: AI that reads human emotion faithfully and offers the right kind of companionship and support.
summary.zh: 让 AI 读懂人的情绪，给出恰当的陪伴与支持。

topics.zh: 有记忆、有人格的 AI 伙伴

cover.alt: Illustration: a friendly companion robot between speech bubbles and small hearts

summary.en: Models that understand video, images and text, put to work on real tasks.
summary.zh: 让模型读懂视频、图像与文字，并落到真实场景中。

topics.zh: 视频时刻检索与高光检测
多模态信息检索与审核

cover.alt: Illustration: an image, a video and a text bubble flowing into an eye that reads them

summary.en: Why safety alignment works, why it can be bypassed, and how to keep multimodal models safe.
summary.zh: 解释安全对齐为何有效、为何会被绕过，并为多模态大模型构建防护闭环。

cover.alt: Illustration: arrows bouncing off protective rings around a shield with a padlock

summary.en: Robots that perceive, plan and act reliably through long tasks, and keep improving after deployment.
summary.zh: 让机器人在长周期任务中看得懂、想得清、做得稳。

topics.zh: VLA 模型的测试时自适应
工业场景中的精细操作

cover.alt: Illustration: a robot arm lifting a block to stack it on others
